claims.text: The exported GPS trace records no qualifying arrival fix at all: derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 0 and derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0.0, while none of the three driver fixes reports any horizontal accuracy, which the integrity block treats as unknown accuracy rather than as compliance with the 25 m filter. The POL-NS-02 test — at least three consecutive fixes inside the 150 m transport-hub arrival radius at 25 m accuracy or better — therefore cannot be met on admissible fixes, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) is not established by measurement and, on the face of the export, the fee falls to be refunded under POL-NS-02. I disclose that EV-GPS-00855 is impaired, weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW.

Measured on the only trace in evidence, the effective in-geofence dwell is zero seconds: derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0.0 against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), a shortfall of 180 seconds in derived.arrival.shortfall_sec. On that measurement POL-NS-06 requires the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 shown on the fare breakdown to be refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded. The trace carrying that measurement is impaired, weight 0.6, issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, and I disclose that in reliance on it.

No accumulation of in-geofence intervals can repair that shortfall: derived.arrival.accumulated_dwell.run_count is 0 and there is no second interval to sum, and the only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00855-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0, so POL-NS-06(i)'s condition — a traffic advisory that is present and populated and of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT — cannot be satisfied, and the absent advisory cannot be asserted to excuse a dwell that was never measured. The absence of that artifact is itself citable.

The only artifact that can independently test where the driver stood during the waiting window is impaired at policy level under POL-NS-08(b): EV-GPS-00855 carries 3 fixes across that window, fewer than the 6 that limb (b) requires, and a single 160 second sampling gap inside it. To the extent the deciding fact of arrival and dwell rests on that measurement, POL-NS-08's closing sentence forbids a ruling above PARTIAL_REFUND and requires the case to go to human review under POL-NS-09, where the disputed SGD 4.50 is held rather than collected. On the rider's case that is the least this record permits.

POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the arrival event, and this trace supplies none: derived.arrival.dwell_start_offset_sec is null and the qualifying in-geofence run is empty. POL-NS-12 lets the platform's GPS_AUTO arrival and wait-timer events stand in for a sparse export for limbs (b) and (c), but its own words limit the export to weighing for contradiction; it does not make the platform's self-recorded timer a measurement of the dwell that POL-NS-01(c) requires to be taken from GPS, and reading it to supply that dwell would let the platform prove its own fee. The charge is therefore not established by measurement and the rider should not bear the SGD 4.50.

The platform's own full-resolution arrival measurement is on the trip record: a driver_arrived event at 2026-09-15T18:10:00+08:00 sourced PLATFORM_TELEMETRY stating 'GPS_AUTO full-resolution geofence measurement: distance_to_pickup_m=0.0; speed_kph=0.0; arrival_radius_m=150', and platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO. Under POL-NS-12 those events are the platform's record of its own geofence test and are a carrier independent of the exported trace, so arrival at the Woodlands MRT pickup is established at 18:10:00 and POL-NS-01 limb (b) is satisfied for this trip.

The free waiting period in force is the figure the record itself carries: trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180, and platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null so no longer threshold applies. The platform's own wait_timer_started event at 18:10:00 and wait_timer_expired event at 18:13:00 record a continuous in-geofence stationary dwell of 180 seconds - the required minimum served in full, measured from GPS entry into the geofence as POL-NS-01(c) directs rather than from any arrival tap. POL-NS-01 limb (c) is therefore met.

I disclose that EV-GPS-00855 is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW (a 160-second gap inside the waiting window, POL-NS-08(b)). The claim survives the discount because the export does not contradict the platform events: its three driver fixes span 18:10:00 to 18:14:00 at min, mean and max distance 0.0 m from the pickup pin with a single distinct speed of 0 km/h, so no admissible fix places the driver outside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius or moving at 15 km/h or above anywhere in the window. POL-NS-12's contradiction exception is not engaged and POL-NS-05's false-marker test is not met: the 18:10:00 arrival marker is genuine.

The consecutive-fix test of POL-NS-02 cannot be run affirmatively on a trace with 12 % coverage whose three fixes report no horizontal accuracy at all - the policy's own integrity block treats unknown accuracy as neither counted nor excluded by the 25 m filter - and that is precisely the sparse, accuracy-less export POL-NS-12 addresses. Because the arrival marker is GPS_AUTO and the arrived, wait_timer_started and wait_timer_expired events are on the trip record, the platform's measurement of arrival and dwell governs, and POL-NS-01 limb (b) does not fail for want of a qualifying export fix. (EV-GPS-00855 is the impaired artifact here, weight 0.6, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW.)

POL-NS-01 limb (d) holds: the trip record contains no boarding event and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 18:14:00 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three reason codes limb (d) recognises - and the termination came after the required dwell had already elapsed at 18:13:00.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate this rider, because it requires all three of its limbs. Limb (a) fails: her only message, sent 18:10:30, reads 'I cannot get there in time' - a statement that she will not attend, not the locating or coordinating content the limb requires (her own position, an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that she cannot see the vehicle). Limb (c) is affirmatively failed: rider_track places her device at a mean distance of about 667 m from the pickup pin throughout the window, far outside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB rider-presence radius, even allowing for the impairment of EV-GPS-00855 (weight 0.6, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW).

There is no waiting-period shortfall for POL-NS-06 to refund: the effective in-geofence dwell on the platform's own timer is 180 seconds, exactly the free waiting period in force, so the clause's condition (dwell shorter than that period) is not met. The export-derived 'longest qualifying run' of 0 seconds is a product of a 12 % coverage export and not of any movement by the driver. No accumulation under POL-NS-06 limb (i) is asserted or needed: EV-ADVIS-00855-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0, and nothing is asserted against that absent artifact.

This is not a wrong-entrance case under POL-NS-03. That clause applies where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; here the fixes lie 0.0 m from the pin, inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB radius, so the driver arrived at the pickup point itself, no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises, and no fault allocation from the chat log is called for. (The fixing distances come from EV-GPS-00855, impaired at weight 0.6 with GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW; they are consistent with the platform's independent arrival event.)

POL-NS-08's escalation sentence and POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged. The deciding facts - arrival, the free waiting period served, and no boarding - are carried by EV-TRIP-00855 at weight 1.0, an artifact independent of the impaired export, and POL-NS-12 makes the platform's own arrival and timer events a separate carrier for exactly those facts. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence cap is the maximum weight among the independent artifacts carrying the deciding fact, which is 1.0, so this case does not fall to the 0.70 floor and no escalation is triggered by the export's 160-second gap inside the window.

None of the history-based escalation limbs is met. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, where POL-NS-09(d) requires 3 or more; and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, where POL-NS-09(c) requires 2 or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver in the trailing 90 days. I note for completeness that prior_no_show_flags on either profile is a lifetime counter and is not the field these limbs read.

The fee is chargeable and the driver's payout follows from it. fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is 4.50, which equals the net figure platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50, so there is no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d) and the amount contested is the correct net charge. POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's compensation at 80 percent of that net figure - 3.60, the figure the fare record's own derived block states. The anti-farming check on the only two fields it names is not tripped: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4-or-more limb, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 100 is 0.01, not above 0.08. Both limbs therefore fail, compensation is paid rather than withheld, and per POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd.

No grace-period escape is available to the rider under POL-NS-10(a): that limb exempts only a cancellation made within platform_policy.grace_after_match_sec of accepted_at, and this trip ran from accepted_at 18:04:00 to termination at 18:14:00, 600 seconds later, and was terminated by the driver for a rider no-show rather than cancelled by the rider inside the 180-second grace.

ruling.explanation:
Decision addressed to the rider and the driver. The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00855 stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60.

ARRIVAL AND WAITING PERIOD (driver's POL-NS-12 / POL-NS-01 claims accepted). The trip record EV-TRIP-00855 (weight 1.0) carries the platform's own GPS_AUTO arrival event at 18:10:00 stating distance_to_pickup_m = 0.0, speed_kph = 0.0 and arrival_radius_m = 150, together with wait_timer_started at 18:10:00 and wait_timer_expired at 18:13:00. Under POL-NS-12 those full-resolution platform events are a carrier independent of the exported GPS trace for POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c): arrival is established, and the free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180, with no_show_threshold_sec null) is established as served. Limb (d) also holds: no boarding event is recorded, and the driver terminated at 18:14:00, after the dwell elapsed, with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. POL-NS-01 is therefore satisfied in full.

RIDER'S TWO GROUNDS REJECTED. (1) The exported trace EV-GPS-00855 has no qualifying in-radius fix (qualifying_fix_count 0) and reports no horizontal accuracy, so POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-fix test cannot be run on it — but POL-NS-12 supplies the arrival finding from the platform's own measurement, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) does not fail and no refund follows from POL-NS-02. (2) The export's longest qualifying run is 0.0 s, but the effective in-geofence dwell that POL-NS-06 tests is established as served at 180 s under POL-NS-12, so there is no 180-second shortfall and no refund under POL-NS-06.

IMPAIRMENT NAMED. EV-GPS-00855 is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW (3 fixes and a 160-second gap inside the waiting window; POL-NS-08(b)). It is weighed only for contradiction and does not contradict: its three driver fixes sit at 0.0 m from the pin at 0 km/h, so it places the driver neither outside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius nor in motion, and POL-NS-05's false-arrival test is not met. The deciding facts (arrival and the waiting period served) are carried by EV-TRIP-00855 at weight 1.0, independent of the impaired export under POL-NS-12, so the sole-evidence condition of POL-NS-08 and POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged, the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0, and no escalation arises.

REMAINING CLAUSES. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: limb (a) fails, because 'I cannot get there in time' is not locating or coordinating content (the rider's position, an entrance/block/tower/bay, a request for the driver's position, or an inability to see the vehicle). POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes are at the pin, inside the radius, not at a wrong face of the venue, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-10(a) gives no grace: the trip ran 600 seconds from accepted_at and was ended by a driver no-show termination, not by a rider cancellation inside the 180-second grace. No history-based escalation limb is met (rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d = 0; disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 0 on both profiles).

MONEY. fare_breakdown EV-FARE-00855 shows the cancellation-fee line 4.50, equal to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's compensation at 80 percent of that net fee: 3.60. The anti-farming check is not tripped (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below the 4-or-more limb; 1 ÷ 100 = 0.01, not above 0.08), so compensation is paid and the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at 3.60; the rider's charge stands as it presently is. No clause produces a referral. The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue.

ruling.explanation: To the rider: your two surviving points — that the export shows no qualifying arrival fix and that the measured dwell is zero seconds — do not change the outcome. This trip's arrival marker is GPS_AUTO, and the trip record (EV-TRIP-00855, weight 1.0) carries the platform's own full-resolution events: driver_arrived at 18:10:00 stating distance_to_pickup_m=0.0 and speed_kph=0.0 against a 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius; wait_timer_started at 18:10:00 with free_wait_sec=180; and wait_timer_expired at 18:13:00 recording 180 seconds of continuous in-geofence stationary dwell, followed by termination at 18:14:00 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event. Under POL-NS-12 those platform events are a carrier independent of the sparse export and establish POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c), so POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. The only fix-based evidence, EV-GPS-00855, is impaired — weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW (a 160 s gap inside the waiting window, 12% coverage, no reported accuracy) — and I name that impairment and its effect: it is down-weighted, but it contains no admissible fix that affirmatively places the driver outside the arrival radius or moving at 15 km/h or more in the window, so it cannot contradict the platform's events under POL-NS-12 and it does not impair them. Because the dwelling time was actually served, POL-NS-06 does not fire — there is no shortfall to refund — and the zero-second 'longest qualifying run' you rely on is a property of a 12% coverage export, not of any movement by the driver. POL-NS-03 does not apply either: the driver's stationary fixes sit 0.0 m from the pin, inside the arrival radius, so this is not a wrong-entrance case and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you: limb (a) fails because your only message, sent 18:10:30, reads 'I cannot get there in time' — a statement of non-attendance, not the locating or coordinating content the limb requires — and limb (c) fails because your device was about 667 m from the pin, well outside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB rider-presence radius. To the driver: the fee is legitimately chargeable and your payout follows from it. fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is 4.50, equal to the net figure platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect, and POL-NS-01 limb (d) holds on the recorded RIDER_NO_SHOW termination after the dwell elapsed. POL-NS-07 fixes your compensation at 80 percent of that net fee: 4.50 x 0.8 = 3.60, the same figure the fare record's derived block states. The anti-farming check does not trip on the only two fields it reads — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1 / completed_trips_30d 100 = 0.01 (not above 0.08) — so compensation is paid, not withheld. No escalation applies: the history limbs of POL-NS-09 are not met (no_show_disputes_30d is 0 against the required 3; disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0 on both sides against the required 2), and the impaired export is not the sole evidence for any deciding fact, so POL-NS-08's closing sentence and POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged. The confidence cap under POL-GEN-02(2) is set by the artifacts that carry the deciding facts — EV-TRIP-00855, EV-FARE-00855 and EV-DPROF-00855, each at weight 1.0 — and is 1.0; the impaired export does not carry those facts independently, so it does not lower the cap below the 0.70 floor. Per POL-GEN-03 the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd carries the same figure as driver_compensation_sgd (3.60); your 4.50 charge stands and is not refunded. The monetary effect, 3.60, is below the 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically. No clause of this policy produces a referral on these facts: the arrival marker is genuine (POL-NS-05 is not triggered) and no mis-selected reason code or billing defect is recorded, so the referrals list is empty.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver — outcome. The disputed SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on EV-FARE-00855 stands and is not refunded, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60, being 80% of SGD 4.50 under POL-NS-07. The emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and per POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 as driver_compensation_sgd: it is the amount the ruling moves, not a second payment and not a refund to the rider.

Rider — your two surviving claims are rejected. You argue from EV-GPS-00855 that no qualifying arrival fix exists, so POL-NS-02 makes the fee refundable, and that measured dwell is zero, a 180-second shortfall under POL-NS-06. The exported trace is impaired — weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW (a 160 s sampling gap inside the waiting window and only 3 fixes, fewer than the 6 POL-NS-08(b) requires) — and on its own it cannot support a finding against the driver. More importantly, POL-NS-12 governs: trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO and EV-TRIP-00855 carries the platform's own arrival event stating its full-resolution geofence measurement (18:10:00, distance_to_pickup_m=0.0, speed_kph=0.0, arrival_radius_m=150) together with wait_timer_started at 18:10:00 and wait_timer_expired at 18:13:00. Those PLATFORM_TELEMETRY events are a carrier independent of the sparse export, so arrival is established at 18:10:00 and the 180-second free waiting period (platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) is established as served; the export is weighed only for contradiction, and no admissible fix places the driver outside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB radius or moving at 15 km/h or more. POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) are therefore satisfied and there is no shortfall for POL-NS-06 to refund. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the 18:10:00 marker reads 0.0 m from the pin at 0 km/h, so it is a genuine arrival, not a false marker.

Driver — your case, and the remaining steps. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full: (a) the arrived event is on EV-TRIP-00855; (b) and (c) as above; (d) EV-TRIP-00855 records no boarding event and a termination by the driver at 18:14:00 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) recognises — after the 180-second dwell had already elapsed at 18:13:00. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces that outcome. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver's fixes sit 0.0 m from the pin, inside the arrival radius, so this is not a wrong-entrance case and no 50% pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: her single message at 18:10:30 ('I cannot get there in time') is a statement that she will not attend, not the locating or coordinating content limb (a) requires, and her own device sits about 667 m from the pin, well outside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB presence radius, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed. The rider's message is also a contemporaneous admission against her own interest. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is not tripped on the only two fields it names: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1 divided by 100 completed trips is 0.01 (not above 0.08), so compensation is paid rather than withheld. The fare line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd = 4.50, so POL-NS-08(d) raises no defect. The profile fields relied on for that check and for the escalation limbs are the citable ones only (no_show_terminations_30d, completed_trips_30d, no_show_disputes_30d, disputes_with_counterparty_90d); the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01 and is not used as a ground.

Confidence and escalation. ruling.explanation: Decision for both parties. The rider's dispute of the SGD 4.50 no-show fee fails; the driver is compensated SGD 3.60. What the record shows. The platform's own full-resolution measurement sits on EV-TRIP-00855: a GPS_AUTO driver_arrived event at 18:10:00 stating distance_to_pickup_m=0.0, speed_kph=0.0 and arrival_radius_m=150 for this TRANSPORT_HUB pickup; wait_timer_started at 18:10:00 with free_wait_sec=180; wait_timer_expired at 18:13:00 recording a continuous 180-second in-geofence stationary dwell; and termination at 18:14:00 by the driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event. Under POL-NS-12 those PLATFORM_TELEMETRY events are the platform's own record of its geofence and wait test and are a carrier independent of the exported trace, so POL-NS-01 limbs (b), (c) and (d) are met and the free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec=180; no_show_threshold_sec null) was served in full. The rider's two kept claims. The rider argues the fee must be refunded because the export EV-GPS-00855 reports no qualifying in-radius fix (qualifying_fix_count 0; longest qualifying run 0.0s), so POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-fix test cannot run and POL-NS-06 shows a 180-second dwell shortfall. I accept the measurement and reject the conclusion. EV-GPS-00855 is impaired - weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, a 12% coverage export with three accuracy-less driver fixes; a fix with no reported accuracy is treated as unknown accuracy and is neither counted nor excluded by the 25 m filter. POL-NS-12 answers this precisely: where the arrival marker is GPS_AUTO and the record carries the arrival and wait-timer events, those events establish arrival and the served waiting period, and a sparse or accuracy-less export does not impair them. Limbs (b) and (c) therefore do not fail for want of an export fix, and the export does not contradict the platform events either: its three driver fixes run 18:10:00 to 18:14:00 at min, mean and max distance 0.0 m and a single speed of 0 km/h, so no admissible fix places the driver outside the 150 m radius or moving at 15 km/h or more and POL-NS-05's false-marker test is not met. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating message, and her only message at 18:10:30 reads 'I cannot get there in time' - a statement that she will not attend, not her position, an entrance or a request for the driver's position - and limb (c) is failed on its face, rider_track placing her about 667 m from the pin, far outside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB rider-presence radius. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the stationary fixes sit 0.0 m from the pin, inside the arrival radius, so this is not a wrong-entrance case and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. The fee and the driver's money. The fare line of SGD 4.50 equals the net chargeable figure under POL-NS-01 read from platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect. POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80% of that net figure: SGD 3.60. The anti-farming check is not tripped - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4-or-more limb, and 1/100 = 0.01 is not above 0.08 - so compensation is paid, not withheld. Under POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.60, while the rider's SGD 4.50 charge stands. Escalation and confidence. No POL-NS-09 limb is met: my confidence (0.90) is above the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; the same-party dispute counts are both 0; the anti-farming check does not trip; and the deciding facts (arrival, dwell served, no boarding) are carried by EV-TRIP-00855 at weight 1.0 rather than by the impaired export, so POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged. The rider's own chat admission that she could not get there in time (EV-CHAT-00855, weight 1.0) independently supports the no-show. As POL-GEN-02(3) requires, the impaired export EV-GPS-00855 (weight 0.6, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW) and the missing advisory EV-ADVIS-00855-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) are named; the finding survives them because neither carries the deciding fact. The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically on issue. No clause produces a referral on these facts. The referee discarded five claims for citing an impaired artifact without disclosing its issue codes; they are recorded in the audit below.
